query:
select
                rd.product_id,
                rd.req_id
            from RequirementDescendants rd
            where
                rd.agg_collect_nr = $1
                and rd.req_collect_nr = rd.descendant_collect_nr
                and rd.product_id = rd.descendant_product_id
                and rd.req_id = rd.descendant_req_id
